title: Ancient & classical
blurb: The first empires: the Mauryas, the Satavahanas of the Deccan, the Guptas and the Chalukyas of Badami.

title: Regional kingdoms
blurb: Palas, Pratiharas and Rashtrakutas fight over Kannauj; the Cholas sail to Southeast Asia; the Yadavas rule from Devagiri.

title: Sultanates & the Mughals
blurb: Delhi's sultans, Vijayanagara and the Deccan Sultanates, and the Mughal Empire.

title: The Marathas
blurb: Shivaji's swarajya, the Peshwas who made it an empire, and the great houses that ruled on after 1818.

title: Mysore, the Sikhs & the Raj
blurb: The last kingdoms to hold out against the East India Company, and British rule itself.

title: Modern India
blurb: The leaders of the freedom struggle, and the Sangh, the BJP and Narendra Modi after independence.

title: Japan
blurb: From the warring states to the Meiji Restoration.
